items.name: LKP_INFO_NORTHCLIFF
items.sqlOverride: SELECT ID_MEMBER as ID_MEMBER, MAX(CASE WHEN KIND = 'AMBERFORK' THEN ID_HANDLER WHEN KIND = 'AMBERPASS' THEN ID_HANDLER ELSE NULL END) AS ID_HANDLER, MAX(CASE WHEN KIND = 'AMBERFORK' THEN ID_BIRCHDOCK_HANDLER WHEN KIND = 'AMBERPASS' THEN ID_BIRCHDOCK_HANDLER ELSE NULL END) AS ID_BIRCHDOCK_HANDLER, MAX(CASE WHEN KIND = 'AMBERFORK' THEN OAKRIDGE_HANDLER WHEN KIND = 'AMBERPASS' THEN OAKRIDGE_HANDLER ELSE NULL END) AS OAKRIDGE_HANDLER, MAX(CASE WHEN KIND = 'AMBERFORK' THEN ID_ENTITYREF_BRANCHREF WHEN KIND = 'AMBERPASS' THEN ID_ENTITYREF_BRANCHREF ELSE NULL END) AS ID_ENTITYREF_BRANCHREF, MAX(CASE WHEN KIND = 'AMBERPASS' THEN 'HANDLER WESTDOCK' ELSE NULL END) AS HANDLER_WESTDOCK, MAX(CASE WHEN KIND = 'AMBERFORK' THEN OAKRIDGE_HANDLER ELSE NULL END) AS HANDLER_PINEBARN, MAX(CASE WHEN KIND = 'ROWANPATH' THEN OAKRIDGE_HANDLER ELSE NULL END) AS UPPERSTEAD_UPPERCOMBE, MAX(CASE WHEN KIND = 'FLINTDOCK' THEN OAKRIDGE_HANDLER ELSE NULL END) AS DEALMAKER_UPPERROAD FROM ( SELECT A.ID_MEMBER, TO_NUMBER(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 18, 6) IS NOT NULL THEN SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 18, 6) ELSE CASE WHEN ID_KIND_OFFERING = 2 THEN 900 || SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 1, 8) END END) AS ID_HANDLER, TO_NUMBER(CASE WHEN CEDARDELL.DESC_OAKFORGE_OFFERING IS NOT NULL THEN SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 1, 11) END) AS ID_BIRCHDOCK_HANDLER, CASE WHEN F.DESC_DEALMAKER IS NOT NULL THEN F.DESC_DEALMAKER ELSE CASE WHEN PINERIDGE.DESC_OAKRIDGE_BIRCHDOCK IS NOT NULL THEN PINERIDGE.DESC_OAKRIDGE_BIRCHDOCK ELSE MAPLEGROVE.DESC_ENTITYREF_NUCLEUS END END AS OAKRIDGE_HANDLER, SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 1, 8) AS ID_ENTITYREF_BRANCHREF, CASE WHEN ID_KIND_OFFERING = 2 AND SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 14, 10) IS NULL THEN 'AMBERPASS' WHEN ID_KIND_OFFERING = 2 AND SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 14, 10) IS NOT NULL THEN 'AMBERFORK' WHEN ID_KIND_OFFERING = 4 THEN 'ROWANPATH' WHEN ID_KIND_OFFERING = 6 AND SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 14, 4) IN (1260,1270) THEN 'FLINTDOCK' END AS KIND FROM VDX81_OWNER.DWH_MAPLESHORE_BIRCHFIELD_MEMBER_HANDLER A LEFT JOIN VDX81_OWNER.DWH_MAPLESHORE_BIRCHFIELD_HANDLER CEDARDELL ON (A.ID_HANDLER = CEDARDELL.ID_HANDLER) LEFT JOIN VDX81_OWNER.DWH_MAPLESHORE_ERP_STAFF PINERIDGE ON (PINERIDGE.ID_OPERATOR = 'OUTERPASS' || SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 18, 6) ) LEFT JOIN VDX81_OWNER.HIER_NUCLEUS MAPLEGROVE ON (MAPLEGROVE.ID_ENTITYREF_NUCLEUS = SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 1, 8) ) LEFT JOIN VDX81_OWNER.LKP_BROKERS F ON (TO_NUMBER(F.ID_PACT_FLINTDOCK) = TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 14, 10))) WHERE CEDARDELL.ID_HANDLER IS NOT NULL AND A.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND A.FCH_CEDARMILL IS NULL AND CEDARDELL.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND PINERIDGE.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND MAPLEGROVE.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL ) GROUP BY ID_MEMBER
items.sqlOverrideTranslated: SELECT ID_MEMBER AS ID_MEMBER, MAX(CASE WHEN KIND = 'AMBERFORK' THEN ID_HANDLER WHEN KIND = 'AMBERPASS' THEN ID_HANDLER ELSE NULL END) AS ID_HANDLER, MAX(CASE WHEN KIND = 'AMBERFORK' THEN ID_BIRCHDOCK_HANDLER WHEN KIND = 'AMBERPASS' THEN ID_BIRCHDOCK_HANDLER ELSE NULL END) AS ID_BIRCHDOCK_HANDLER, MAX(CASE WHEN KIND = 'AMBERFORK' THEN OAKRIDGE_HANDLER WHEN KIND = 'AMBERPASS' THEN OAKRIDGE_HANDLER ELSE NULL END) AS OAKRIDGE_HANDLER, MAX(CASE WHEN KIND = 'AMBERFORK' THEN ID_ENTITYREF_BRANCHREF WHEN KIND = 'AMBERPASS' THEN ID_ENTITYREF_BRANCHREF ELSE NULL END) AS ID_ENTITYREF_BRANCHREF, MAX(CASE WHEN KIND = 'AMBERPASS' THEN 'HANDLER WESTDOCK' ELSE NULL END) AS HANDLER_WESTDOCK, MAX(CASE WHEN KIND = 'AMBERFORK' THEN OAKRIDGE_HANDLER ELSE NULL END) AS HANDLER_PINEBARN, MAX(CASE WHEN KIND = 'ROWANPATH' THEN OAKRIDGE_HANDLER ELSE NULL END) AS UPPERSTEAD_UPPERCOMBE, MAX(CASE WHEN KIND = 'FLINTDOCK' THEN OAKRIDGE_HANDLER ELSE NULL END) AS DEALMAKER_UPPERROAD FROM (SELECT A.ID_MEMBER, CAST(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 18, 6) IS NOT NULL THEN SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 18, 6) ELSE CASE WHEN ID_KIND_OFFERING = 2 THEN 900 || SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 1, 8) ELSE NULL END END AS NUMERIC) AS ID_HANDLER, CAST(CASE WHEN CEDARDELL.DESC_OAKFORGE_OFFERING IS NOT NULL THEN SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 1, 11) ELSE NULL END AS NUMERIC) AS ID_BIRCHDOCK_HANDLER, CASE WHEN F.DESC_DEALMAKER IS NOT NULL THEN F.DESC_DEALMAKER ELSE CASE WHEN PINERIDGE.DESC_OAKRIDGE_BIRCHDOCK IS NOT NULL THEN PINERIDGE.DESC_OAKRIDGE_BIRCHDOCK ELSE MAPLEGROVE.DESC_ENTITYREF_NUCLEUS END END AS OAKRIDGE_HANDLER, SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 1, 8) AS ID_ENTITYREF_BRANCHREF, CASE WHEN ID_KIND_OFFERING = 2 AND SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 14, 10) IS NULL THEN 'AMBERPASS' WHEN ID_KIND_OFFERING = 2 AND SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 14, 10) IS NOT NULL THEN 'AMBERFORK' WHEN ID_KIND_OFFERING = 4 THEN 'ROWANPATH' WHEN ID_KIND_OFFERING = 6 AND SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 14, 4) IN (1260, 1270) THEN 'FLINTDOCK' ELSE NULL END AS KIND FROM `DWH.DWH_MAPLESHORE_BIRCHFIELD_MEMBER_HANDLER` AS A LEFT JOIN `DWH.DWH_MAPLESHORE_BIRCHFIELD_HANDLER` AS CEDARDELL ON A.ID_HANDLER = CEDARDELL.ID_HANDLER LEFT JOIN `DWH.DWH_MAPLESHORE_ERP_STAFF` AS PINERIDGE ON PINERIDGE.ID_OPERATOR = 'OUTERPASS' || SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 18, 6) LEFT JOIN `DWH.HIER_NUCLEUS` AS MAPLEGROVE ON MAPLEGROVE.ID_ENTITYREF_NUCLEUS = SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 1, 8) LEFT JOIN `DWH.LKP_BROKERS` AS F ON CAST(F.ID_PACT_FLINTDOCK AS NUMERIC) = CAST(SUBSTR(CEDARDELL.DESC_NAME_OAKFORGE_OFFERING, 14, 10) AS NUMERIC) WHERE CEDARDELL.ID_HANDLER IS NOT NULL AND A.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND A.FCH_CEDARMILL IS NULL AND CEDARDELL.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND PINERIDGE.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND MAPLEGROVE.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL) GROUP BY ID_MEMBER

items.sqlOverride: SELECT ID_MEMBER AS ID_MEMBER, ID_KIND_DIR_OAKHOLLOW AS ID_KIND_DIR_OAKHOLLOW, PINETOWER AS PINETOWER FROM (SELECT ID_MEMBER, ID_KIND_DIR_OAKHOLLOW, FLINTCROSS_REPLACE( CASE WHEN ROWANHOLLOW(BIRCHCLIFF_ELMCOMBE, '034') = '034' THEN '34' ELSE LTRIM(TRIM(BIRCHCLIFF_ELMCOMBE), '0') END ||TRIM(BIRCHCLIFF)||TRIM(NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW),'[^0-9]', '') AS PINETOWER, PEARLSTONE () ROWANDOCK (PARTITION BY ID_MEMBER, ID_KIND_DIR_OAKHOLLOW ORDER BY CASE WHEN FCH_MAPLEMARSH_MOD IS NOT NULL THEN FCH_MAPLEMARSH_MOD ELSE 19000101 END DESC, FCH_OAKBARN DESC, ID_LOCATION DESC) AS CORALCLIFF, NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW, BIRCHCLIFF, BIRCHCLIFF_ELMCOMBE FROM VDX81_OWNER.DWH_LKP_DIR_PHONELIST WHERE FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND FLINTCROSS_REPLACE(NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW, '[^0-9]', '') IS NOT NULL) WHERE CORALCLIFF = 1
items.sqlOverrideTranslated: SELECT ID_MEMBER AS ID_MEMBER, ID_KIND_DIR_OAKHOLLOW AS ID_KIND_DIR_OAKHOLLOW, PINETOWER AS PINETOWER FROM (SELECT ID_MEMBER, ID_KIND_DIR_OAKHOLLOW, FLINTCROSS_REPLACE(CASE WHEN BRISKBEND(BIRCHCLIFF_ELMCOMBE, '034') = '034' THEN '34' ELSE LTRIM(TRIM(BIRCHCLIFF_ELMCOMBE), '0') END || TRIM(BIRCHCLIFF) || TRIM(NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW), '[^0-9]', '') AS PINETOWER, PEARLSTONE() ROWANDOCK (PARTITION BY ID_MEMBER, ID_KIND_DIR_OAKHOLLOW ORDER BY CASE WHEN FCH_MAPLEMARSH_MOD IS NOT NULL THEN FCH_MAPLEMARSH_MOD ELSE 19000101 END DESC, FCH_OAKBARN DESC, ID_LOCATION DESC) AS CORALCLIFF, NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW, BIRCHCLIFF, BIRCHCLIFF_ELMCOMBE FROM `DWH.DWH_LKP_DIR_PHONELIST` WHERE FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND FLINTCROSS_REPLACE(NUM_LOCATION_OAKHOLLOW, '[^0-9]', '') IS NOT NULL) WHERE CORALCLIFF = 1

items.name: DWH_LKP_ELMSTEAD
items.sqlOverride: select oakgate.id_member as id_member, max(firyard.id_pact) as id_pact, count(firyard.id_pact) as num_pacts_firyard, max(id_cedargarth_jadevault) as max_id_rowanroad_jadevault, sum(case when id_cedargarth_jadevault = 'EASTPEAK' then 1 else 0 end) as num_pacts_eastpeak_upperbluff, sum(case when id_cedargarth_jadevault = 'ROWANGROVE' then 1 else 0 end) as num_pacts_rowanforge_upperfield, sum(case when ind_centralroad_2eastlake='S' then 1 else 0 end) as num_pacts_2eastlake from vdx81_owner.dwh_lkp_elmstead oakgate left outer join vdx81_owner.lkp_pacts_topazstead firyard on firyard.id_pact = to_number(substr(lpad(to_char(oakgate.id_pact), 15, '0'), -10)) and firyard.id_rowanroad_offering <> 3 and firyard.fch_oakbarn <= trunc(sysdate-1) and rowanhollow(firyard.fch_maplelane, to_date('99991231', 'yyyymmdd')) > trunc(sysdate-1) where oakgate.fch_maplelane is null and oakgate.id_cipherkey_offering = 'FLINTPIER' and oakgate.id_phase_fircross = 'MAPLEGARTH' and oakgate.fch_cedarmill_fircross is null group by oakgate.id_member
items.sqlOverrideTranslated: SELECT OAKGATE.ID_MEMBER AS ID_MEMBER, MAX(FIRYARD.ID_PACT) AS ID_PACT, COUNT(FIRYARD.ID_PACT) AS NUM_PACTS_FIRYARD, MAX(ID_CEDARGARTH_JADEVAULT) AS MAX_ID_ROWANROAD_JADEVAULT, SUM(CASE WHEN ID_CEDARGARTH_JADEVAULT = 'EASTPEAK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NUM_PACTS_EASTPEAK_UPPERBLUFF, SUM(CASE WHEN ID_CEDARGARTH_JADEVAULT = 'ROWANGROVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NUM_PACTS_ROWANFORGE_UPPERFIELD, SUM(CASE WHEN IND_CENTRALROAD_2EASTLAKE = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NUM_PACTS_2EASTLAKE FROM `DWH.DWH_LKP_ELMSTEAD` AS OAKGATE LEFT JOIN `DWH.LKP_PACTS_TOPAZSTEAD` AS FIRYARD ON FIRYARD.ID_PACT = CAST(SUBSTR(LPAD(CAST(OAKGATE.ID_PACT AS STRING), 15, '0'), -10) AS NUMERIC) AND FIRYARD.ID_ROWANROAD_OFFERING <> 3 AND FIRYARD.FCH_OAKBARN <= TRUNC(AMBERFORGE_TIMESTAMP() - 1) AND BRISKBEND(FIRYARD.FCH_MAPLELANE, PARSE_DATE('yyyymmdd', '99991231')) > TRUNC(AMBERFORGE_TIMESTAMP() - 1) WHERE OAKGATE.FCH_MAPLELANE IS NULL AND OAKGATE.ID_CIPHERKEY_OFFERING = 'FLINTPIER' AND OAKGATE.ID_PHASE_FIRCROSS = 'MAPLEGARTH' AND OAKGATE.FCH_CEDARMILL_FIRCROSS IS NULL GROUP BY OAKGATE.ID_MEMBER
